gloss: surgical procedure; (in fantasy fiction) spell technique

definitions.explanation: The method used in a surgical operation. A medical term.

definitions.gloss: spell technique; magic formula (in fantasy fiction)
definitions.explanation: In manga, anime and games, the particular technique or formula a character uses to cast magic; widely known from 『{呪術廻戦|じゅじゅつかいせん}』.
